description: Monotonic coverage ratchet for RTL decode datapath. Coverage may ONLY go up. A change that reduces covered pixels/blocks/MBs is a FAIL regardless of correctness.

luma_residual.description: dequant + IDCT + clip (no prediction). Tests residual arithmetic pipeline.
luma_residual.notes: Currently: 1 block of MB(0,0). Prediction hardcoded to 128 at decode_stub.sv:151.

luma_prediction.description: Intra prediction (I4x4, I16x16). RTL intra_pred modules.
luma_prediction.notes: NOT INSTANTIATED. h264_intra4x4_pred and h264_intra16x16_pred exist in source but are wired nowhere in fpga/Plex_MiSTer/rtl/. Coverage legitimately 0.

luma_reconstruction.description: prediction + residual = final luma pixel. Full path.
luma_reconstruction.notes: Only MB(0,0) block 0. Prediction is 128 (not real intra), so recon = clip(128 + residual).

chroma_residual.description: Chroma AC dequant + IDCT. Same modules as luma but chroma QP.
chroma_residual.notes: NOT WIRED. Chroma path absent from decode_stub. Zero coverage is honest.

chroma_dc_hadamard.description: 2x2 inverse Hadamard for chroma DC coefficients.
chroma_dc_hadamard.notes: NOT IN RTL. w-plane implementing (57518d2). Absent from all 33 RTL files.

chroma_prediction.description: Chroma intra prediction (DC, H, V, Plane modes).
chroma_prediction.notes: Module exists and is verified at module-level (300/300 chroma pred). NOT instantiated in pipeline.

chroma_reconstruction.description: Chroma prediction + residual = final U/V pixel.

deblock.description: In-loop deblocking filter applied to reconstructed frame.
deblock.notes: w-deblock building. Not instantiated in pipeline.

monotonic_rule: A commit that reduces any min_* value is a HARD FAIL. Coverage may only increase. This ratchet is rebaselined only when a new stage is wired, never when one regresses.
